A proven mismatch may be treated as stale, with the mismatch recorded.

Create immutable per-account/per-side plan decisions whose identity includes state hash, bar, active-set identity, gate/control context (including halt file digest and matched halt record), account admission, broker-held quantity, planner output and notes. Before sending OPEN/AUGMENT, require a same-bar plan-decision record authorizing that exact action and reference its decision_id/context hash on ORDER; on absent/mismatched provenance, log a critical error and hold the entry until a fresh decision is recorded. Apply the forward patch independently to current Mac source 402ba407 and S1 live source d0db497 after deployment owner review.
